content: Klaviyo flows: trigger-based automation (event/list/date), Trigger Split (branch on trigger property) and Conditional Split (branch on any profile/event property) nodes, time delay steps, Smart Sending (skip contacts recently emailed), A/B testing both at flow-branch level (conditional split) and at individual email level (subject/content/send-time) with auto-pick-winner by open/click rate after statistical significance.
